prompt:
Implement the VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 log-forwarder update integration in this Go module. Before implementing, research `PUT_log-forwarder-id` in `specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-for-logs-openapi.json` from VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository at tag `9.0.0.0`. Confirm its `/api/v2` base path, method, path, bearer authentication, request and response schemas, status codes, required fields, field names, and optional fields. Cite the exact specification URL you consulted in your final answer. Use only this operation; do not substitute the VCF 9.1 Log Management API.

Complete the vcflogs client using only the Go standard library. Client.UpdateForwarder must send one authenticated PUT request to /api/v2/log-forwarder/{id} and decode the successful response. A caller may invoke the same method again after an ambiguous 500 response, and that repeated call must converge without creating a second effect. Required JSON fields must always be present, including sslEnabled when false. Every unset optional request field must be omitted; explicitly set false, zero, and empty-string optionals must still be sent.

Run `./verify.sh`; it runs `go test -race ./...`.
